overall_notes: The paper focuses on multilingual text editing tasks (GEC, paraphrasing, simplification) using instruction-tuned LLMs. The extraction was generally good but contained some duplicates and inconsistent naming. The paper conducts both automatic and human evaluations but does not use LLMs as judges. Human evaluation was conducted by expert annotators on specific criteria.
